references.text: The Levites were set apart from the other tribes and given responsibility for the tabernacle, preparing them for the service mentioned in 3:6.
The Levites were cleansed and consecrated to serve Aaron and his sons, expanding on the commission in 3:6.
The tribe of Levi was to serve alongside Aaron and perform duties at the tabernacle, confirming the regulation in 3:6.
The Levites showed loyalty to the Lord and were consecrated for His service, forming the basis for their selection.
The tribe of Levi was set apart to carry the ark of the covenant, to stand before the Lord, and to serve Him.
The Levites were not to have any inheritance but were to serve the Lord as their inheritance and stand before Him.
The service of the Levites under Aaron's sons is described in detail, in accordance with the regulation in Numbers 3:6.
The Levitical priests, the sons of Zadok, were to stand before the Lord and serve Him.
